title: Squishing Insects for Preservation of HMW DNA in the Field
author: Fiona Teltscher

steps.title: Kill the mosquito
steps.instruction: Transfer the live caught mosquito into 100% ethanol to kill it.

steps.title: Transfer mosquito to preservation liquid
steps.instruction: Move the mosquito into a preservation tube with an appropriate volume of liquid to ensure the specimen remains fully submerged.

substeps.instruction: Remove the mosquito from 100% ethanol using clean forceps.
Gently dab the mosquito on a clean wipe (e.g., Kimtech wipe) to dry remaining ethanol.

Transfer the mosquito into a 0.5 mL Eppendorf tube (or similar, e.g., Safe-Lock Tube 0030121023) filled with 400 µL of preservation liquid (options include 100% EtOH, EDTA, DESS, or commercial solutions).

Note: If using ethanol for preservation, the specimen can be preserved directly in the killing ethanol, provided there is sufficient volume to submerge the insect without spilling when inserting a pestle.

steps.title: Squish the insect cuticle
steps.instruction: Break the insect cuticle using a pestle to allow the preservation solution to penetrate the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Select a clean pestle appropriate for the tube and insect size (e.g., Starlab I1405-4390 for 0.5 mL tubes).
Insert the pestle and position the tip next to the mosquito.
Gently press the mosquito against the wall of the tube until the cuticle is felt to crack.
Ensure the mosquito remains in one piece and minimize tissue leaking into the fluid.

steps.title: Store or ship the specimen
steps.instruction: Prepare the specimen for transport or long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Ship the specimen at room temperature or store at the coldest available temperature.
If a -70°C freezer is available, remove the liquid (unless using ethanol) and snap freeze the specimen.
